# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 8 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Sinaiticus (ch 1-31) / P.Mich. 130 (ch 32+), Shepherd of Hermas 8 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_008_page_001.jpg

---

## Vision 2, Chapter 4

**1** After she had finished speaking with me she said to me, "Do you wish to know anything else?" I asked her, "Lady, why is the tower built upon waters?" "Because," she said, "your life was saved and shall be saved through water; but the tower has been founded on the word of the all-powerful and glorious Name, and it is maintained by the invisible power of the Lord." **2** I answered and said to her, "Lady, this is a great and marvelous thing. But who are the six young men building it?" "These," she said, "are the holy angels of God who were the first created, to whom the Lord delivered all his creation to increase and build and rule. Through them the Lord will complete the building." **3** "And the other people who bring the stones — who are they?" "These also are holy angels of God, but the six are superior. The building will be completed and all shall rejoice together around the tower and shall glorify God, because the tower is completed." **4** I asked and said, "Lady, I would like to know what becomes of the stones, where they go." She said, "The stones rejected and cast away — these are those who have sinned and wish to repent, and since they are not yet placed in the building they have not gone far away. These, if they repent, will indeed be placed in the building. But if the tower is completed before they repent, they will be rejected. **5** The cracked ones — these are those who have believed and are hypocrites in the most of them, and there is no integrity in them; for they blow hot and cold, but their works are wicked. **6** And the ones thrown far away — they are the sons of lawlessness. They have received the faith, but their iniquity has not departed from them. Therefore they are not useful for the building and have been thrown far away on account of God's wrath, for their wicked actions have aroused the Lord to wrath. **7** And the rest, which you saw lying around in great numbers without being placed in the building — the rough ones are those who have known the truth but did not remain in it, nor do they consort with the saints; therefore they are useless. **8** And the ones with the cracks — these are those who bear malice against one another in their hearts and are not at peace among themselves; but they have a peaceable appearance, and when they part from one another the malice remains in their hearts. These are the cracks which the stones have. **9** And those thrown into the fire and burnt — these are those who have departed altogether from the living God, and it has no more come into their hearts to repent on account of their lustful ways of life and the wickednesses which they committed." **10** "And the ones near the water, but unable to roll in?" "These are those who have heard the word and wished to be baptized in the name of the Lord; but then when the true holiness of the truth was recalled before them, they changed their mind and went back to their wicked desires." **11** She finished speaking with me about the tower. "But do you ask no more about the tower? These words are sufficient; yet pay careful attention to them." She then commanded the virgins, saying, "Be diligent to build the tower lest the master grow impatient because of the delay in the building and go to some other means." After she spoke these things she went away, and the young men who were building came along with her, and all the virgins who were around the tower. I saw nothing of the tower, only the stones upon the ground.

---

*EMET note: Vision 2 chapter 4 completes the tower interpretation. "Blow hot and cold" renders a Greek idiom for inconsistency. The virgins appear without prior introduction.*
